TC-P09-010 Acquisition codeur : mise en service nominale
TC-P09-011 Preset READBACK_ONLY : commit atomique apres relecture 500ms
TC-P09-012 Preset READBACK_AND_STATUSBIT : bit FALSE refuse sans valider
TC-P09-013 Echec relecture 50mm : suspicion et diagnostic sans validation
TC-P09-014 STATUSBIT_ONLY : bit TRUE valide la transaction
TC-P09-015 Reset conscient : acquitte le latch sans valider le preset
TC-P09-016 Fault live : perte materiel codeur (Cause 0)
TC-P09-017 Fault latched : echec preset + acquittement Reset (Cause 2)
TC-P09-018 Fault live : incoherence mesure (Cause 1)
TC-P09-050 Mesure de vitesse : filtrage fenetre glissante 50ms et robustesse aux perturbations dynamiques (elasticite cable et vibrations)
TC-P09-010.1 Abs gel sur doute : perte bus -> EncoderAvailable=FALSE, RawPos gele
TC-P09-010.3 Abs acquisition nominale : bus OK -> RawPos=RawPosIn, EncoderAvailable
TC-P09-010.4 Abs preset : front PresetRequest -> PresetTriggerCmd=2
TC-P09-020 Homing : sequence nominale complete (front Home + capteur haut) -> Homed
TC-P09-020.1 Homing nominal : front Home + capteur haut -> cible CfgTopSensorPosM
TC-P09-020.2 Homing unitaire : front Home seul -> cible CfgHomingTargetM
TC-P09-020.3 Homing dynamique : front UseDynamicTarget -> cible DynamicHomingTargetM
TC-P09-020.4 Homing cible hors plage : cible > 99m -> refuse, pas d ecriture
TC-P09-020.5 Coherence boot : ecart RawPos/LastKnown > tolerance -> HomingSuspect, leve par ConfirmCoherence+Permit
TC-P09-020.6 Capteur haut absent : mode nominal ne declenche pas, seul unitaire/dynamique
TC-P09-020.7 Homing sans permit : front Home sans HomingPermit -> HomingModeError, pas d ecriture
TC-P09-020.8 HomingSuspect RETAIN : stocke dans Calib -> persiste (FB_Encoder_Homing.st:185)
TC-P09-030.1 Scale : RawPos=HomingRefRaw+4096 (1/2 tour) -> CablePosM=1.0
TC-P09-030.2 Scale : RawPos < HomingRefRaw -> CablePosM negative (sous l eau)
TC-P09-030.4 Safety bornage : CablePosM hors [Min;Max] -> EncoderIncoherent, auto-efface
TC-P09-030.5 Safety HomingSuspect : HomingSuspect=TRUE -> EncoderIncoherent, tant que non confirme
TC-P09-030.6 Safety BypassGlobal : TRUE neutralise bornage+coherence, retour FALSE -> causes reactives
TC-P09-030.7 Safety CablePosMSafe : = CablePosM toujours (jamais gelee)
TC-P09-030.8 Scale garde DINT : conversion DINT avant soustraction -> pas de depassement
TC-P09-030.9 Scale : RawPos=HomingRefRaw -> CablePosM=0.0
TC-P09-040.1 Reliability : EncoderAvailable=TRUE, Homed=FALSE, Incoherent=FALSE -> EncoderFault=FALSE
TC-P09-040.2 Reliability : meme cas -> HomedAndReliable=FALSE (gate stricte exige Homed)
TC-P09-040.3 Reliability : EncoderAvailable=FALSE -> EncoderFault=TRUE quel que soit Homed
TC-P09-040.4 Reliability : table de verite des 2 gates sur 8 combos
TC-P09-040.5 Reliability : EncoderIncoherent -> EncoderFault=TRUE et HomedAndReliable=FALSE
TC-P09-050.5 Speed : fenetre <50ms -> Valid=FALSE sans purge (essai SITE - stub logique)
TC-P09-050.6 Speed : SignedSpeed=(P[5]-P[0])/WindowElapsed, Speed=ABS
